description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) MIGHT IS RIGHT (Warboss, passive): after a charge move this turn its melee weapons have +3 A and +2 S. Fixture ork11e_ab_fight: the Warboss charged (charged_this_turn) and is engaged with the Shield-Captain. A real click on 'Fight' for the Warboss, attacks assigned and resolved through the real dialogs: every melee hit roll the Warboss made has 3 more attacks than the weapon profile the engine resolved (one model). Setup privileges: auto wound allocation, the Custodes' wounds inflated (the fight must not end the scenario). The Custodes player's IN AURAMITE CLAD card (WP-C5, offered when the Warboss targets the Shield-Captain) is declined with a real click (WP-FIX1).

steps.comment: EPIC CHALLENGE prompt for a CHARACTER fighter — not under test, declined

real click: the Custodes player declines IN AURAMITE CLAD (not under test)
the Warboss (one model) rolled the weapon's profile attacks + 3
